description: Create an application with a development instance in the connected workspace (like `clerk apps create`). Returns the new application_id, name, and instances with their publishable keys. Secret keys are removed, or returned as encrypted_secret_key when recipient_public_key is set.

name.description: Name for the application, shown in the Clerk Dashboard.

recipient_public_key.description: RSA public key to encrypt secret keys to: a JWK, or base64, base64url, or hex SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER, with a 2048 to 4096-bit modulus and exponent 65537. Each secret key then comes back as encrypted_secret_key, unpadded base64url RSA-OAEP ciphertext with SHA-256 for OAEP and MGF1 and an empty label, which only the matching private key can decrypt.

template.description: Clerk template that pre-configures the application for a use case. Omit to create it with Clerk's default settings.

workspace.description: The workspace to act in, as its ID or name. A workspace is the Clerk Dashboard organization that owns the applications, not an Organization inside an application (those go in `organization_id` on the tools that have it). Only needed when this connection covers several workspaces; the error for a missing choice lists them.

name: create_application
title: Create Clerk application
